description: This script is a helper utility for managing a Coocook instance within a Docker environment. It provides command-line options for deploying, serving, and displaying help information related to the Coocook application, including handling command-line arguments and executing external deployment and server scripts.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Executes the deployment script with specified flags.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Starts the server script with specified flags.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message in red color.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Returns a formatted warning message in yellow color.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for commands or subcommands.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information on how to use the script.
